relationships.subject: GluN2B-containing NMDA receptors
relationships.object: low-frequency stimulation-induced synaptic depression in ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: synaptic depression in potentiated synapses was dependent on GluN2B-containing NMDA receptors

key_findings: LFS depresses TBS-induced LTP in mouse ACC only within a short time window (30 but not 90 min)
Depression after potentiation requires NMDA receptors, specifically GluN2B, not GluN2A or GluN2C/D
